mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_4, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_5, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_6, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_7, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN reward_fenlei = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_8 FROM sys_reward WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) AS stats ON a.userId = stats.user_id SET a.sjjxcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_1, 0), a.sjkxjsj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_2, 0), a.sjyljpkpb = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_3, 0), a.stjjzrkxlpj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_4, 0), a.stjjsklpj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_5, 0), a.xjjxcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_6, 0), a.yyxkyxjcgj = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_7, 0), a.xjjpkpb = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_8, 0)
